title: Generative Edge Detection with Stable Diffusion (GED)
mechanism: Fine-tunes the Stable Diffusion denoising U-Net to predict latent edge maps in one step, with granularity as a condition and a granularity regularisation.
adaptation: Same VAE-latent risk as DiffusionEdge for 1 px cracks, so the reconstruction gate comes first. Use source label style as the granularity condition.
min_experiment: Gate: SD VAE reconstruction IoU of GT crack maps >= 0.9. Arm: GED on crack, 3 seeds. Baseline: house. Metric: relF1@2. Kill at the gate or if relF1@2 is below the house model.
